borough: London Borough of Hammersmith and Fulham
description: Variation of condition 2 of plannig permission ref: 2025/00842/FUL granted 31st July 2025 for the 'Erection of a rear roof extension; erection of a rear extension at second floor level, over part of the existing back addition; removal of part of the pitched roof to form a new flat roof, and erection of 1.7m high opaque glazed balustrade on top in connection with its use as a roof terrace to the rear elevation at second floor level; alterations to the existing first floor back addition to include, bricking up 1no. window to the side elevation, and formation of a new door opening with the installation of new door and window to the rear elevation; erection of an external spiral staircase, to the rear elevation leading from first floor back addition into the rear garden. Installation of three rooflights to the front roof elevation' to allow amendments to the approved drawings to include: installation of a new rooflight above the roof of first floor rear back addition.
